text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
JERUSALEM POST
- Labour party plank allows for Palestinian state.
- High Court of Justice delays decision on four Bar-On scandal petitions.
- Squabble over Swiss fund led to Elie Wiesel's refusal to join.
- Verdict today in trial of former justice minister Yaacov Neeman.
- Local authority heads blockade office of Finance Minister Dan Meridor in protest at his refusal to consider their demands for increased budgets.
- Bank of Israel calls for creation of monetary council.
- Clal Trading, Ze'ev Gura mull sale of Clal Pharm.
- Drop in sales but narrowing of losses at Indigo, beleaguered manufacturer of electronic colour printing products.
- Gilat Satellite Networks up 15 percent to $3.1 million.
- American International Group: Mideast political twists don't affect us.
GLOBES
- Globes survey: Economic slowdown worsens.
- Meridor: Getting out of the slowdown in economic activity will take many months.
- April inflation of 1.1 to 1.2 percent expected.
- Record unemployment in April; number of jobseekers exceeds 140,000 for the first time since January 1994.
HAARETZ
- Disagreement among High Court judges in Bar-On affair.
- Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy to tell U.S. Secretary of State Madeleine Albright: Israel wants understanding with U.S. on nature of final-status accord.
- Schools on strike in 250 local authorities.
- Prime minister's office acting to transfer $2 million to ultra-Orthodox Jewish Habad institutions.
- Labour party leader Shimon Peres: I'll not join a government with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
- In Belgium and Austria, a halt to sales of weapons to shops in Israel, so they'll not be used against Palestinians.
MAARIV
- Uncertainty in the political echelons over delay of High Court decision.
- Despite peace crisis: Qatar will host economic conference with Israel.
- Industrialist George Soros again engaged in contacts to buy one of the big Israeli banks -- Hapoalim or Leumi.
- New in the Shin Bet: Soon women too will be mobilised in state protection unit.
YEDIOTH AHRONOTH
- Yigal Amir: When I shot Rabin I felt as if I were shooting a terrorist.
- Doctors in the Gaza Strip suspected of planning attacks, arrested with 200 other activists of Islamic Jihad.
